ns2:course.label: Sophomore Business Honors Seminar
ns2:course.description: Required for all sophomores in the Gies College of Business Honors Program. The course structure is divided into four focused learning modules: Negotiations, Intercultural Communications, Disruption, and Project Management. Prerequisite: Second-year student in the Gies Business Honors program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Second-year student in the Gies Business Honors program.
